fields.label: KMS Key ID
fields.help: The identifier for your AWS Key Management Service key (AWS KMS key).

fields.label: Name
fields.help: An identifier you assign to the stream processor.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints).

fields.label: Role Arn
fields.help: The Amazon Resource Number (ARN) of the IAM role that allows access to the stream processor.

fields.label: Data Sharing Preference
Opt In
fields.help: Do you want to share data with Rekognition to improve model performance.
Shows whether you are sharing data with Rekognition to improve model performance.

fields.label: Input
Kinesis Video Stream
Arn
fields.help: ARN of the Kinesis video stream stream that streams the source video.
Kinesis video stream stream that provides the source streaming video for a Amazon Rekognition Video stream processor.
Information about the source streaming video.

fields.label: Notification Channel
Sns Topic Arn
fields.help: The Amazon Resource Number (ARN) of the Amazon Amazon Simple Notification Service topic to which Amazon Rekognition posts the completion status.
The Amazon Simple Notification Service topic to which Amazon Rekognition publishes the object detection results and completion status of a video analysis operation.

fields.label: Output
Kinesis Data Stream
Arn
fields.help: ARN of the output Amazon Kinesis Data Streams stream.
The Amazon Kinesis Data Streams stream to which the Amazon Rekognition stream processor streams the analysis results.

fields.label: S3 Destination
Bucket
fields.help: The name of the Amazon S3 bucket you want to associate with the streaming video project.

fields.label: Key Prefix
fields.help: The prefix value of the location within the bucket that you want the information to be published to.
The Amazon S3 bucket location to which Amazon Rekognition publishes the detailed inference results of a video analysis operation.
Kinesis data stream stream or Amazon S3 bucket location to which Amazon Rekognition Video puts the analysis results.

fields.label: Bounding Box
Height
fields.help: Height of the bounding box as a ratio of the overall image height.

fields.label: Left
fields.help: Left coordinate of the bounding box as a ratio of overall image width.

fields.label: Top
fields.help: Top coordinate of the bounding box as a ratio of overall image height.

fields.label: Width
fields.help: Width of the bounding box as a ratio of the overall image width.
The box representing a region of interest on screen.

fields.label: Polygon
X
fields.help: The value of the X coordinate for a point on a Polygon.

fields.label: Y
fields.help: The value of the Y coordinate for a point on a Polygon.
Specifies a shape made of 3 to 10 Point objects that define a region of interest.

fields.label: Settings
Connected Home
Labels
fields.help: Specifies what you want to detect in the video, such as people, packages, or pets.

fields.label: Min Confidence
fields.help: The minimum confidence required to label an object in the video.
Label detection settings to use on a streaming video.

fields.label: Face Search
Collection ID
fields.help: The ID of a collection that contains faces that you want to search for.

fields.label: Face Match Threshold
fields.help: Minimum face match confidence score that must be met to return a result for a recognized face.
Face search settings to use on a streaming video.
Input parameters used in a streaming video analyzed by a stream processor.

fields.label: Delete
fields.help: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m".

fields.label: Update
fields.help: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m".
